column3: Keep your wits on you, partner. Wouldn't want anyone to get hurt.
This is nature! It is glory!
Aah, even defeat is soothing here.
If only the city's haze didn't eclipse the view.

Spread Honey across the tree bark.
Wild Pokémon flocked to the Honey at once!
The bark is covered with Honey. If you come back later, a Pokémon may appear.
The animous Heracross attacked!
Pinsir nods appreciatively.
Pinsir crushed the log into bits!
Pinsir quickly fled.
The angry Pinsir attacked!
Heracross bows appreciatively.
Heracross tore down the spider web!
Heracross absconded peacefully.
You saw that just now, didn't you?
???: Don't assume you know what's going on.
Don't bother lying.
Do us both a favor, and stay out of this.
Got it?
I don't know what sort of hero-complex you've got ingrained into your head that you feel the need to jump into anyone else's business.
But a little piece of advice:
Build yourself a little bridge, and get over it.
The flower's scent lulls \PN into a daze...
\PN's Floral Charm begins to glow! Pull it out?
The charm disappears in a burst of light!

How we doing today? Up for a round?
Ask me if I hate this.
I hate this.
The angry Tauros attacked!
Bouffalant roars triumphantly!
...Bouffalant charged blindly away!
...It sounds like Bouffalant crashed into something!
The angry Bouffalant attacked!
Tauros roars triumphantly!
Tauros seems thankful and compliant.
Do you want to try and ride the Tauros?
Ah, hello again. Have you come to donate a Dunsparce to us?
The Azurine Observation and Breeding Facility has been beyond tardy in their shipments of Pokémon for reintroduction.
We were scheduled to re-establish the Dunsparce population last month, but there's been no word from them.
It is a poor substitute, but, Trainer, should you encounter any Dunsparce, please consider donating them to us.
I will offer you a young Pokémon in return. We had planned to reintroduce them to the wild before, but were forced to cancel that operation.
I understand.
Wonderful! Let's begin at once.
\PN traded Dunsparce for Tyrogue!
This will be an excellent addition to the populations' re-establishment.
In fact, as a small extra thanks, why don't you take this as well?
Some of our old monitoring equipment was deprecated recently, and this was left over.
I hear some Trainers make use of it?
Please keep us in mind if you find any more Dunsparce!
The Miltank is calm and wears a collar.
Tauros is staring at the Miltank intensely.
Miltank-senpai doesn't seem to notice him.
Miltank returns the gaze, becoming lost in Tauros' eyes.
You feel that you could cut the sexual tension with a knife.
Miltank blushes and nuzzles against Tauros. It roars quietly as it breathes down the Miltank's neck.
You kind of want to dismount now.
Miltank bleats coyly and bows down to the Tauros.
You suspect you might be about to witness the live action version of 50 Shades of Bull.
Miltank notices the Oran Berry you hold.
Do you want to give Miltank the Berry?
\PN handed over the Oran Berry.
Miltank is moaning uncomfortably.
Miltank seems to be incredibly uncomfortable.
Miltank seems to be sleeping.
You decide it would be best to not leave the two alone, or else you may have no idea where an Egg came from.
Miltank and Tauros hold each other's gaze for a moment.
You suspect that this is the kind of Miltank that brings all the bulls to the yard in daylight.
Giddy-up!
Woah, there.
You's a fighter, huh.
HO!
Hoo-hah!
Guh... Too much.
Ah, someone else ventured outside the walls. Isn't it better out here?
Your spirit reminds me of someone else.
Even if it's more dangerous here, I'd rather take my chances than be caged up within the walls.
SANDY: Oh, hey \PN!
It's great to see you again!
I heard you fell out of existence for a while or something?
I mean, that happens sometimes, no sweat!
???: Oh, hello there!
Are you the one coming in from the Nightclub?
That's great! I could really use the help!
My name's Sandy! I'm an activist for the sake of Pokémon everywhere!
Anyway, could you help me out here?
This Miltank seems really sick, but for some reason no one in the center wants to do anything about it!
I think she just ate too many Oran Berries and needs to be milked...
Either that or she's pregnant.
But definitely one of the two!
Wait, if Pokémon lay eggs, can they still get pregnant?
Can you be pregnant with an egg???
Eggnant!?!!?
Well, nevermind!
If we can get Miltank's internal temperature we can probably figure out what's wrong!
I already, uh, "borrowed" a thermometer from inside,
And I'm pretty sure I read that the most accurate way to get a reading is through the, uhm, rectum.
The problem is, I've been having trouble getting her to let me check!
So, here's the plan.
I'll hold her steady, and you insert the thermometer and get a read, okay?
No?
...Oh, right! We were supposed to be checking out the Anomalies reported here!
Mmmmmm...
I just can't leave this poor creature to suffer like this, though!
I'm going to help it no matter what!
Can I trust you to look for the Anomalies?
From what I've gathered, there should be one in the North Aventurine Woods, one in the South Aventurine Woods, and another somewhere else near here.
I'll be here for moral support too!
Just let me know if you need a reminder!
SANDY: Baby, come on, this is for your own good!
Just let me put it in!!!
Oh, did you want me to remind you where the thingies were?
Good luck!
Wish me luck too... I clearly need it.
SANDY: Ugh, come on, just let me get it--
Oh, \PN...
Are you having any luck?
I'm sure not...
I finally got to check its temperature, but then the thermometer got stuck in there!
And now she won't let me get it out!!!
Anyway, do you need a reminder?
Say, do you want to switch jobs?
Boo...
The Tauros is absolutely wild!
...Do you want to try and ride it?
...The Tauros charged off!
Got bucked off!
SANDY: Hi, \PN...
...Good news!
The thermometer finally came out of its butt!...
...Also, so did what was apparently the Nature Center staff's entire supply of cream puffs...
They let me clean myself up afterwards, but I know why no one wanted to deal with this now...
\PN, it...
It was awful...
It was everywhere...
I need some time...
SANDY: Did...
Did you find them all?
That's... good.
I'll... just head back now...
Um...
Thanks for your help,
And, yeah, by 'help,' I mean doing the entire thing for me during my extremely traumatic experience...
I think when I go back to the Nightclub, I'm giving up field work.
A desk job sounds great, doesn't it?
Inside.
With the air purifiers.
And no Miltank ever.
That sounds... just lovely...

Vanhanen Castle
\PN obtained Field Effect Read-Out 05!
Info on Chess Arena now available!
Hold it right there!
...Was that convincing?
RADOMUS: Regardless, it seems to have been enough to fool them.
Didn't I say before--
Choose the right hat for the right job?
Of course, one might wonder just how I had such an outfit as this in the first place.
It almost makes me look suspicious.
Now quickly, follow me.
RADOMUS: I cannot stay long, but allow me to leave you with some clarity.
As you must have heard, they have captured Luna.
Unfortunately, I lacked the foresight to teach Luna to Teleport as well.
Though if I could...
More importantly, it would appear my gambit with Elias has not paid off.
After all, a normal Hypnosis only lasts so many turns, no?
It would take a fierce power to play beyond those means, and we may only hope that no such things exist.
Yet, it appears the logical conclusion has left him unmoved.
Still, I can predict his next move.
I suspect she will be somewhere around 7th Street in Reborn City.
For reasons of my own, I must make myself scarce at present.
I ask you go in my stead.
If you can't find that place, I suggest you contact someone who's a bit more familiar with the city's back-alley dealings.
A gang leader in the city of some sort should suffice.
Do you know anyone like that?
On another note, I'll beseech you allow me to keep this Amethyst Pendant a bit longer.
I heard a story once about these 'keys' being purchased from a traveling merchant.
I wonder who that might have been?
As we said before, not all is black and white, or dark and light.
Wrong is sometimes right.
In is often out.
And sometimes up may be the only way down.
All you need to do is read between the lines--
Or rather, walk between them.
Until we meet again, adieu.
Caught you!
Ugh, I should know better by now.
Even if you beat me, I'm not letting you escape!
Hold on, how did you get over here? We had it blocked off.
You already got out, so why are you wasting time fighting me anyway?
I should probably tell the others about this. They'll figure it out.
Intruder sighted!
Aren't you the one we're supposed to catch? Weren't you supposed to be on the inside?
...Huh.
Uh, hi?
So, you won't just get caught for us? Please?
Even if we ask nicely?
???: Hello challenger, and welcome.
Please, follow me.
LUNA: Gardevoir! You're back!
GARDEVOIR: But of course, my dear~
LUNA: Oh, how I've missed you!
Now don't you go off disappearing like that again, please.
GARDEVOIR: Pish posh~
What's a girl without a little excitement in her life, hm?
Besides, I had my Gallade-in-shining-armor come all the way down to rescue me!
RADOMUS: There was hardly much rescuing involved, but indeed.
The perceived crisis has been averted.
LUNA: Oh, Master, you are so wonderful!
I am pleased to be in service to you.
RADOMUS: Now, now. Let's not get ahead of ourselves.
I am but a humble Gallade.
CAIN: Speaking of which, why do you keep changing to all these silly hats?
RADOMUS: You wound me.
There's nothing silly about them.
But to answer your question...
Why not?
RADOMUS: I simply choose the right hat for the right job.
Isn't that sensible?
GARDEVOIR: I'm afraid the peasantry knows nothing of my master's divine taste in fashion.
LUNA: I find them most amusing. Don't you think so?
RADOMUS: Yes, well, speaking of nonsequitur transitions, I have somebody to introduce to you all.
If you would be so kind as to step aside, \PN?
RADOMUS: Please, enter.
CAIN: ...Uhm.
LUNA: That's--
RADOMUS: Everybody, I would like you to meet the estate's newest butler, Elias.
ELIAS: I am pleased to serve.
Do let me know if there is anything I may do to make your stay with us more comfortable.
LUNA: Why...?
RADOMUS: Ah, dear Luna, you look as if you've seen a ghost.
CAIN: It's not a ghost she's seen.
It's her father.
LUNA: I am confused by your words.
Master is my father, and none other.
RADOMUS: Indeed, it is a strange thing to accuse our new attendant of.
Elias, do tell.
Is this girl your daughter?
ELIAS: She is not.
RADOMUS: And as she claims me to be her parent, I believe that this issue can be laid to rest.
LUNA: ...I wish to leave.
I beg your pardon.
GARDEVOIR: Luna, darling! Come back--
Oh, dear.
ELIAS: Have I offended?
RADOMUS: Through no fault of your own, surely.
Pay it no mind.
I understand that you have procured a certain rare object.
Will you please give it to me?
ELIAS: Yes, my Lord.
I believe this is the object to which you refer.
Elias handed over the Amethyst Pendant!
RADOMUS: That will be all. Dismissed.
ELIAS: Understood, my Lord.
CAIN: That's Anna's Pendant! El took it before--
RADOMUS: Yes, you did say something to that effect.
I then meant to ask you, \PN, exactly how did you come by this object?
Of course, I should know better than to ask such a question to a player character with no dialogue.
So perhaps your friend will tell me.
CAIN: Wait, what did you just say?
RADOMUS: Will you tell me where this came from?
CAIN: It belongs to a friend of ours, and she'll be wanting that back, you know?
RADOMUS: Such a precious thing to lose...
Believe me, none could understand better than I.
But in understanding, it is with all my greatest sympathy that I will refuse to return it to you.
For just this once, I will implore you to acquiesce to me on faith alone.
I will keep this object, and you will not find your trust abused.
Now! Onto lighter matters!
I believe we have a Gym Battle to get under way, do we not?
\PN, you will find the doors to the challenge hall open.
Best of luck to you.
CAIN: I'm beginning to doubt if siding with him was really the right thing to do.
He acts so strange, and just ran off with Anna's Pendant like that.
And the fact that Elias had it-- doesn't that mean that he was...
...Hm. This is weird.
RADOMUS: Through no fault of your own, surely. At ease. I'll have further instructions for you later.
CAIN: What are you even doing now?
RADOMUS: Doing?
Merely dismissing my employee for a moment.
CAIN: Nonono, you know what I mean!
That's obviously El! Why are you making him do this?
RADOMUS: El? How foolish.
El despises me. He would never agree to work for me, much less address me as "My Lord".
This butler's name is 'Elias'.
Do not be so blind as to let the similarity of the names confuse you.
That would be altogether rude.
CAIN: Uh huh.
RADOMUS: Regardless, I do have a Gym Battle to fulfill.
I'm sure \PN must be getting impatient.
So, I will bid you adieu, and leave you to your strange notions.
RADOMUS: The butler being El...
Hah! And exactly how would I do such a thing?
Really, what a foolish accusation...
???: My master will join us shortly.
Please, make yourself comfortable if--
???: Oh, well what's this?
A new challenger!
???: One Miss Gossip Gardevoir, at your service!
And don't worry, dear, autographs are always free of charge.
GARDEVOIR: Hm? Haven't you met a Pokémon that can communicate before?
???: Indeed, Gardevoir is unique among her kind to be able to psychically project her thoughts in English.
???: I am Radomus, the lord of this Castle.
It is a pleasure to meet you, challenger.
As she has already alluded to, this Gardevoir belongs to me.
You may have seen her on TV; she's managed quite the career.
And this is my daughter, Luna.
LUNA: As the Castle's maid, I welcome you.
Please let me know if there is anything I can do to make your stay more comfortable.
RADOMUS: And you are \PN, is that not so?
GARDEVOIR: Oh, don't look so surprised that Master knows who you are already~
After all, as Reborn's very own Gossip Gardevoir, it IS my business to know things.
I know all about your repeated raids on the Meteors, your involvement with the other Leaders...
Even your little escapade from the Orphanage~
And how you apparently joined a street gang?
